hotels.title: Portugal Elegance: Sesimbra Beachfront Elegance 60 Minutes from Lisbon with Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Perched above the golden sands of Praia da California and just a one-hour drive from Lisbon, Sesimbra Oceanfront Hotel is your seaside home away from home. Step outside and you’re just minutes from charming old-town lanes lined with whitewashed houses and sea-breeze cafes; a short stroll away, you'll find the medieval Castelo de Sesimbra, a historic clifftop fortress with sweeping bay views. When hunger strikes, MarLuso Restaurant serves up a story on every plate - inspired by Sesimbra’s own 16th-century navigator Sebastiao Rodrigues Soromenho, the menu blends global flavours with hints of Costa Rica, Guatemala and beyond. Grab a table with a sea view and enjoy fresh dishes in a relaxed atmosphere where every bite feels like an adventure. For some downtime, lounge by the rooftop infinity pool and soak up the Atlantic views, or slip into the indoor pool for a quiet, peaceful escape. Poké Bar keeps things light and fun with tropical-inspired bowls and refreshing drinks, while the Wellness Hub offers massages, treatments and self-care rituals designed to leave you feeling totally recharged.
